title: System Requirements
subtitle: Ensure your device meets the minimum requirements to run TaraHive smoothly.

blocks.text: Before installing TaraHive, verify that your device meets the recommended system requirements. Running the application on supported platforms ensures the best performance, security, and user experience.
TaraHive is available on multiple platforms to provide a consistent experience across desktop and mobile devices.

items: Modern web browsers (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, or Safari)

blocks.text: Using the latest version of your operating system and browser is recommended for the best compatibility.
The following specifications are the minimum recommended to run TaraHive.

items: Stable internet connection for synchronization and online features

blocks.text: For the best performance, especially when managing multiple itineraries or collaborating with groups, the following specifications are recommended.

items: At least 1 GB of free storage

blocks.text: Some TaraHive features require access to device permissions.

items: Location access for maps, navigation, and weather services.
Notification permission for reminders and alerts.
Camera access for uploading profile pictures or trip photos.
Storage access for importing or exporting itinerary files.

blocks.text: You can modify these permissions at any time through your device's settings.

An internet connection is required during account creation, synchronization, collaboration, AI-powered recommendations, weather updates, and downloading application updates. Some previously saved information may remain accessible offline depending on the feature.
If your connection is unstable, certain online features may be temporarily unavailable until connectivity is restored.
